c: A Baker Street detective with a pipe, a violin and a very sharp eye.
A dark lord in black armour who breathes like a broken machine.
The vampire hunter with stakes, garlic and a very long night ahead.
A noseless dark wizard who split his soul into seven pieces.
A grey wizard who returns in white after falling with a balrog.
A creature in a cave obsessed with one ring, and he calls it precious.
A brilliant, polite psychiatrist with a very unusual diet.
The shy motel manager who talks with his mother a little too much.
A dancing clown who lives in the sewers of Derry and offers balloons.
Burnt face, razor glove, striped sweater. He visits you in dreams.
The Pumpkin King of Halloween Town, who tries to take over Christmas.
Brooding, vengeful foundling of the Yorkshire moors.
The bell ringer who lives in the towers of Notre-Dame.
A one-legged whaler whose only crew goal is revenge.
Stitched together from the dead and abandoned by the one who made him.
His face never ages. His portrait in the attic does.
